title: Albus Changes the World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The Demon Lord has been defeated and the world is at peace, but Albus the Hero did not make it in time to save what mattered to him. With the power to turn back time, he restarts his journey remembering everything and 'speed-runs' it, forcefully recruiting companions and charging at dangerous monsters to reach a better ending. Viz's tagline asks what a 'perfect' ending costs.
life_message: Knowing what is at stake can drive a person to fight for a better outcome, but even a perfect plan has a cost.
